    latency_cost = latency_cost + interaction * 0.10

    before = max(cpu_before, mem_before)
    incremental_load = max(peak - before, 0.0)

    cost = queue_cost * 0.35 + burst_cost + latency_cost
    cost = cost + incremental_power / 120.0 * 0.25
    return -cost

# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
